methods.name: _overview
methods.summary: Whether this machine has a keychain the app can use, and the items the app shows of it, by service and account. A machine without a keychain is an answer (`keychain.available` is false and says why), not an error. No password is read.

methods.name: _add
methods.summary: Keep a password in the keychain under a service and an account, and show the item. Left without a password, it shows an item the keychain has already, and changes nothing in the keychain.

params.name: service
params.description: What the password is for: a site, a program, a machine. Blank is refused with a message.

params.name: account
params.description: Whose password it is there: a user name, an email address. Blank is refused with a message.

params.name: password
params.description: The password to keep. Left out or empty for an item the keychain has already.

errors.message: The service or the account is blank, the item is shown already, the keychain has a password for it already (or, with no password given, has none), or the keychain refused.

methods.name: _reveal
methods.summary: Read the password of an item from the keychain. The operating system may ask the person at the machine first, and the call waits for them.

params.name: item
params.description: The id of one of the items of `overview`.

errors.message: There is no such item, the keychain no longer has it, its secret is not text, or the keychain refused.

methods.name: _remove
methods.summary: Delete an item from the keychain, and stop showing it. An item the keychain no longer has is only taken off the list.

params.name: item
params.description: The id of one of the items of `overview`.

errors.message: There is no such item, or the keychain refused.

methods.name: list_keychain_items
methods.description: The items of this machine's keychain that the Keychain app shows: what each password is for (`service`) and whose it is there (`account`). No password is given: only the person can look at one, in the app.

methods.name: add_keychain_item
methods.summary: Keep a password in the keychain
methods.description: Keep a new password in this machine's keychain, under what it is for and whose it is, and show the item in the Keychain app. A password the keychain has already for that service and account is not replaced: the call fails and says so.

params.name: service
params.description: What the password is for: a site, a program, a machine

params.name: account
params.description: Whose password it is there: a user name, an email address

methods.name: changed
methods.summary: The items changed outside the window (an agent kept a password): read the overview again.

available.description: This machine has a keychain, and it could be opened.

problem.description: Why it is not available, as a sentence; empty when it is.

Entry.description: An item as an agent is shown it: never its password.
